verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents linking Sentry issues to Jira, GitHub Issues, or Linear, or any two-way status sync between them. The pricing line about 'third-party integrations' is generic. The Issue Status and Webhooks entries are bare page titles that say nothing about ticket-driven resolution or regression reopening. Linking errors to issue trackers is a fair question for an error-monitoring platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can link an error to Jira, GitHub Issues, or Linear with two-way status sync, so fixing the ticket resolves the error and a regression reopens it
